title: Kepler-90i and Kepler-80g
ai_role: A neural network ranked weak transit-like signals in archival Kepler data.
human_role: Researchers selected training data, inspected the signals, and performed astronomical and statistical validation.
novelty_scope: previously missed celestial objects
reported_result: Two previously missed planets were found; Kepler-90 became the first known eight-planet system outside the Solar System.
caveat: The AI did not observe the sky autonomously; it re-analysed archival signals and the discovery still depended on human validation.

title: Seventy-two additional bursts from FRB 121102
ai_role: A convolutional neural network searched a five-hour radio dataset for burst morphology.
human_role: Researchers dedispersed and inspected the returned events and interpreted the burst timing.
evidence_stage: observed signals verified in archival telescope data
novelty_scope: new events from a known source
reported_result: The model recovered 72 bursts missed by the conventional search, raising the dataset total from 21 to 93.
caveat: This was archival re-analysis of a known repeating fast-radio-burst source, not discovery of a new source.

title: SN 2023tyk end-to-end autonomous transient discovery workflow
ai_role: BTSbot classified a transient candidate, triggered robotic spectroscopy, classified the spectrum, and submitted the result without human intervention.
human_role: Humans designed the pipeline, operated the surveys and instruments, and audited the resulting record.
evidence_stage: observed, spectroscopically classified, and publicly reported
novelty_scope: new astronomical transient plus autonomous workflow milestone
reported_result: SN 2023tyk was the first reported transient to complete the discovery-to-classification-to-public-report chain without human action.
caveat: The scientific object was detected by survey infrastructure; the novelty is the AI-orchestrated end-to-end workflow, not autonomous physical interpretation.

title: 109,956 previously unrecognized lunar craters
ai_role: A transfer-learning system detected craters and estimated geologic ages from Chang'E imagery and elevation data.
human_role: Researchers curated training data, assessed error and recovery rates, and interpreted crater chronology.
evidence_stage: peer-reviewed computational mapping with benchmark validation
novelty_scope: previously uncatalogued planetary surface features
reported_result: The study reported 109,956 new craters and estimated formation systems for 18,996 craters larger than 8 km.
caveat: Most entries are model-detected map features rather than individually field-verified objects; age assignments are model estimates.

title: Upper-mantle earthquakes beneath East Antarctica
ai_role: Deep learning with transfer learning detected small seismic events across 49 stations.
human_role: Researchers visually checked waveforms, located events, and interpreted the tectonic mechanism.
evidence_stage: observational catalog with manual waveform checks
novelty_scope: previously unknown earthquake population and process evidence
reported_result: The catalog contained 1,068 events beneath David Glacier, including 510 intermediate-depth earthquakes at roughly 100-150 km, revealing unexpected intraplate seismicity.
caveat: The physical interpretation remains a scientific inference from the newly detected catalog, not a direct measurement of mantle mechanism.

title: 303 new figurative Nazca geoglyphs
ai_role: A deep-learning model prioritized likely geoglyph locations in aerial imagery.
human_role: Archaeologists inspected candidates on the ground and interpreted style, distribution, and use.
novelty_scope: previously undocumented archaeological objects
reported_result: An AI-accelerated six-month survey found 303 new figurative relief-type geoglyphs, nearly doubling the known count of that class and increasing the discovery rate about sixteen-fold.
caveat: AI prioritized survey targets; humans made the archaeological confirmation and interpretation.

title: Uluciala rotundata, the oldest known sepioid
ai_role: A zero-shot segmentation model isolated fossils from full-colour grinding-tomography image stacks without taxon-specific training.
human_role: Paleontologists reconstructed, described, deposited, and taxonomically interpreted the fossils.
evidence_stage: physical specimens, peer-reviewed taxonomy, and open 3D models
novelty_scope: new genus and species plus earliest fossil record
reported_result: Two approximately 74-67 million-year-old beaks defined Uluciala rotundata and provided intermediate morphology between cuttlefish and bobtail squid lineages.
caveat: The AI segmented candidate fossils; the species diagnosis and evolutionary conclusion were human scientific work.

title: Sixfold-improved photocatalyst formulation found by a mobile robotic chemist
ai_role: Bayesian search selected experiments for a mobile robot across a ten-variable formulation space.
human_role: Chemists defined the objective, reagents and apparatus and interpreted the optimized mixture.
novelty_scope: new high-performing formulation
reported_result: The autonomous campaign found a photocatalyst mixture with activity about six times higher than the initial formulations.
caveat: This is discovery of an optimized mixture under a specified assay, not a new fundamental catalytic law or necessarily a new molecule.

title: GNoME stable-material candidate atlas
ai_role: Graph networks predicted stability across a very large inorganic crystal search space.
human_role: Materials scientists constructed the training corpus, recalculated stability, compared against experiments, and assessed limitations.
evidence_stage: published computational atlas with partial experimental matches
novelty_scope: new predicted crystal structures
reported_result: The study reported 2.2 million stable structures, 381,000 on the updated convex hull, 45,500 new prototypes, and 736 matches to independently synthesized structures.
caveat: The headline structures are predictions, not 381,000 synthesized materials; stability can change with better calculations and says little by itself about synthesizability or useful properties.

title: MatterGen target-conditioned inorganic material
ai_role: A diffusion model generated crystal structures conditioned on target properties.
human_role: Scientists selected a candidate, synthesized it, characterized it, and compared the measured property with the design target.
novelty_scope: new AI-designed material candidate
reported_result: A generated material was synthesized as a proof of concept and its measured target property was within about 20% of the requested value.
caveat: One proof-of-concept synthesis does not experimentally validate the much larger generated candidate space or establish manufacturability.

title: Halicin as a broad-spectrum antibacterial
ai_role: A deep neural network learned antibacterial activity and screened a repurposing library plus more than ten million purchasable molecules.
human_role: Researchers tested hits, named halicin, studied mechanism, and ran animal infection experiments.
novelty_scope: new antibacterial function for an existing molecule
reported_result: Halicin showed broad bactericidal activity and efficacy in mouse models of Clostridioides difficile and pan-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii; eight additional antibacterial hits emerged from 23 tested predictions.
caveat: Halicin was an existing molecule repurposed for a newly identified function; it remains preclinical and is not an approved antibiotic.

title: Abaucin, a narrow-spectrum Acinetobacter baumannii antibiotic
ai_role: A neural network trained on roughly 7,500 screened compounds prioritized structurally distinct molecules.
human_role: Researchers performed susceptibility, resistance, genetic, mechanistic, and mouse-wound experiments.
evidence_stage: in vitro, mechanism studies, and mouse model
novelty_scope: new antibacterial candidate and target pathway
reported_result: Abaucin selectively inhibited A. baumannii, implicated LolE-dependent lipoprotein trafficking, and reduced bacterial burden in a mouse wound model.
caveat: This is a preclinical lead, not a medicine proven safe or effective in humans.

title: Explainable-AI antibiotic class active against MRSA and VRE
ai_role: Graph neural networks plus explainability filters screened more than twelve million compounds for predicted activity and low human-cell toxicity.
human_role: Researchers tested 283 compounds, analysed structure and resistance, and ran mouse infection models.
evidence_stage: in vitro, resistance studies, and mouse models
novelty_scope: new structural class of antibacterial candidates
reported_result: The study identified a structurally distinct class active against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and vancomycin-resistant enterococci, with low resistance frequency and reduced bacterial titres in mouse models.
caveat: The compounds are preclinical; explainability highlighted learned substructures but did not make the model or biological mechanism fully understood.

title: BRD-K56819078 as a senolytic lead
ai_role: A graph neural network trained on a 2,352-compound senolytic screen ranked more than 800,000 molecules.
human_role: Researchers tested prioritized compounds in cells and evaluated a lead in aged mice.
novelty_scope: new senolytic candidate
reported_result: Three drug-like senolytic candidates were validated; BRD-K56819078 reduced senescent-cell burden and senescence-associated gene expression in aged mouse kidneys.
caveat: Mouse and cell results do not establish rejuvenation, lifespan extension, safety, or efficacy in people.

title: Antibiotic candidates reconstructed from extinct proteomes
discovery_class: candidate discovery from ancient sequence space
ai_role: APEX machine-learning models mined 10,311,899 ancient protein sequences and prioritized encrypted antimicrobial peptides.
human_role: Researchers synthesized 69 candidates and performed microbiology and mouse infection experiments.
novelty_scope: previously unknown peptide antibiotics from extinct organisms
reported_result: The system predicted 37,176 broad-spectrum candidates, including 11,035 absent from living organisms; multiple synthesized leads were active in mouse infection models.
caveat: Most predicted peptides were not synthesized, and the validated leads remain preclinical.

title: NG1 and DN1 de novo antibiotics
ai_role: Generative deep-learning systems searched more than ten million fragment combinations and designed chemically novel compounds.
human_role: Chemists synthesized 24 candidates; biologists tested activity, selectivity, mechanism, resistance, and mouse infection models.
novelty_scope: de novo antibiotic structures and distinct mechanisms
reported_result: Seven of 24 synthesized designs were selectively active; NG1 and DN1 reduced bacterial burden in mouse gonorrhoea and MRSA skin-infection models and acted through distinct mechanisms.
caveat: These are early preclinical leads, not approved drugs; only a tiny fraction of the generated chemical space was synthesized.

title: TNIK and rentosertib for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
ai_role: Generative AI contributed to identifying TNIK as a fibrosis target and designing the small-molecule inhibitor rentosertib.
human_role: Researchers performed preclinical studies and a 71-participant randomized phase 2a trial.
novelty_scope: new therapeutic target and AI-designed clinical candidate
reported_result: Over 12 weeks, the 60 mg once-daily arm showed a mean FVC change of +98.4 ml versus -20.3 ml for placebo, while the study primarily assessed safety and tolerability.
caveat: The trial was small and short, FVC was secondary, 16 of 71 participants withdrew, liver-related toxicity caused several discontinuations, and efficacy is not established.

title: MP20 and A1 against multidrug-resistant Neisseria gonorrhoeae
ai_role: A graph neural network trained on 38,650 measured molecules virtually screened about six million compounds.
human_role: Researchers tested 213 predictions, investigated mechanism, and used a human vagina-on-a-chip and mouse infection model.
evidence_stage: in vitro, organ-on-chip, and mouse model
novelty_scope: new selective antibacterial candidates and mechanism
reported_result: Eighty-three of 213 tested predictions inhibited N. gonorrhoeae; MP20 and A1 were structurally unlike existing antibiotics, and A1 was shown to target alanine racemase.
caveat: These are preclinical candidates and have not been shown safe or effective in human patients.

title: Co-Scientist acute myeloid leukaemia candidates
ai_role: A multi-agent Gemini system searched and critiqued drug-repurposing and combination hypotheses under expert constraints.
human_role: Oncologists curated proposals and researchers performed independent dose-response experiments in cancer and control cell lines.
novelty_scope: new indication hypotheses and combinations
reported_result: The system proposed active AML candidates and combinations; KIRA6 showed selective cytotoxicity with an approximately eighteen-fold separation between KG-1a AML and TK6 control cells.
caveat: Cell-line activity is preliminary; several hits had prior rationale, and none of the reported AML uses or combinations is clinically validated.

title: Co-Scientist epigenetic targets and repurposing hypotheses for liver fibrosis
ai_role: A multi-agent system generated and ranked epigenetic target hypotheses and matching drugs.
human_role: Experts selected three hypotheses and researchers tested them in human hepatic organoids with live-cell imaging.
novelty_scope: new target hypotheses and repurposed candidate uses
reported_result: Two of three selected target-drug hypotheses showed significant anti-fibrotic activity without detected cellular toxicity; one effective drug was vorinostat.
caveat: Organoid results are not evidence of safety or efficacy in patients; one candidate is approved for a different indication only.

title: Ripasudil, KL001 and ABCA1 hypotheses for dry age-related macular degeneration
ai_role: The Robin multi-agent system proposed drugs, requested analyses, interpreted returned results, and iterated its hypotheses.
human_role: Researchers selected the problem, performed cell experiments and RNA sequencing, and checked AI analyses against human analyses.
evidence_stage: in vitro validation in cell lines and geriatric primary human RPE cells
novelty_scope: new repurposing and mechanism hypotheses
reported_result: Ripasudil enhanced retinal-pigment-epithelium phagocytosis, KL001 was identified as a previously unproposed enhancer, and RNA-seq supported ABCA1 upregulation.
caveat: The authors state that in vivo validation is still required; these are not validated treatments for dry AMD.

title: LucaProt RNA-virus candidate atlas
ai_role: A deep-learning model identified highly divergent RNA-dependent RNA polymerases in 10,487 metatranscriptomes.
human_role: Researchers curated datasets, built phylogenies, and confirmed a subset with RT-PCR and RNA-versus-DNA sequencing.
evidence_stage: published computational atlas with targeted molecular checks
novelty_scope: putative new RNA-virus species and supergroups
reported_result: The study reported 161,979 putative RNA-virus species across 180 supergroups; tens of thousands were described as previously unknown.
caveat: These are sequence-defined putative species, not 161,979 isolated, cultured, or individually validated viruses.

title: Contextual and combinatorial structure in sperm-whale codas
ai_role: Machine-learning and statistical analyses modelled 8,719 codas from an Eastern Caribbean sperm-whale clan.
human_role: Researchers collected and annotated recordings and interpreted the discovered acoustic features.
novelty_scope: previously undescribed communication structure
reported_result: The analysis identified rubato and ornamentation and showed that rhythm, tempo, rubato and ornamentation combine contextually, greatly expanding distinguishable coda patterns.
caveat: The work did not translate whale language or establish the semantic meaning of codas, and it studied one social clan.

title: Whole adult Drosophila brain connectome
ai_role: Convolutional neural networks performed image alignment and initial neuron segmentation across electron-microscopy volumes.
human_role: A large community manually proofread segmentation and assigned biological annotations, estimated at about 33 person-years of work.
novelty_scope: first complete adult fly-brain wiring atlas at synaptic resolution
reported_result: The atlas reconstructed 139,255 neurons and more than 50 million synapses, enabling circuit-wide biological analyses.
caveat: This is a major AI-enabled map, not an autonomous AI discovery; proofreading and interpretation were deeply human.

title: Higher-order like-to-like wiring rule in mouse visual cortex
ai_role: AI-assisted functional modelling linked visual responses to a dense electron-microscopy connectome and tested wiring hypotheses.
human_role: Researchers designed the experiments, imaged tissue and activity, reconstructed circuits, and interpreted connectivity statistics.
novelty_scope: new organizing rule for neural connectivity
reported_result: Beyond pairwise like-to-like connectivity, neurons sharing downstream targets were more functionally similar than pairwise rules predicted, revealing higher-order network structure.
caveat: The result comes from a bounded mouse visual-cortex volume and should not be generalized to the whole brain or humans without further evidence.
